name: queue-agent-demo
description: Desktop automation agent demo built with Tauri and React: lives in the system tray, polls a mocked job queue, processes one job at a time with a live log, and persists settings to a real config file. No backend and no network calls.

paragraphs: A fully working desktop application (Tauri + React) that demonstrates the shape of a background automation agent: it lives in the system tray, polls a mocked job queue on an interval, processes jobs one at a time with a live log, and exposes a Settings screen to control the AI model, effort level, working directory and polling behavior. Everything (the queue, the jobs, the settings) is simulated in memory and in a local config file. There is no external backend, no real queue, no real AI provider, and no network calls of any kind.
This project is a portfolio piece: it is not connected to, and does not depend on, any production system.
